summary: Implemented four pure/app-local Phase 3 modules (composer-state, get-teacher-authoring-status-view, LessonComposer, AuthoredLessonPreview) plus a teacher-gated route at /teacher/content-authoring with a ?preview=1 mode for UX browser review. Targeted gate exits 0 with 121/121 tests passing (53 new Phase 3 tests + 68 Phase 1/Phase 2 tests still green). Reuses Phase 1 normalize/validate/sanitize and Phase 2 teacherFacingStatus / rejectionComment DTOs; no parallel validation, no new activity types, no raw HTML injection. Lint, tsc, and the knowledge-space-core workspace test all exit 0.
nonblocking_findings: Aggregate command (apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib + components + convex) shows 9 pre-existing file failures / 27 pre-existing test failures in unrelated modules (objectiveProficiency, schema-blueprint, schema-vany-audit, ActivityRenderer-graphing-explorer, practice-blueprint, problem-families-modules-6-9). Documented per test-strategy.md §3; no Phase 3 regressions.

The Phase 2 client adapter is wired to no-op stubs in the route scaffold so the page is reachable for UX browser review; the real Convex client (saveTeacherDraft/submitDraftForReview/editRejectedDraft) wiring lands when Phase 4 E2E hydration is in scope. This is a documented follow-up, not a blocker for Phase 3 acceptance.
